name: Expedition Feature
summary: Expedition Role Feature Outrider After you use Outrider’s Escape, your next attack before your next turn has advantage. Claim-Staker Deep Scan reveals two useful facts instead of one. Trail Gunner Your Trail Gunner damage becomes +1d8, and that hit ignores light cover.
